segments.name: Frozen Beverages and Food
segments.description: Makes and distributes ready-to-drink and ready-to-blend frozen smoothies, shakes, frappes and juice pops for institutional and school customers.
segments.evidence: Barfresh is a leader in the creation, manufacturing and distribution of ready-to-drink and ready-to-blend frozen beverages and food.

segments.name: Raw and Processed Milk
segments.description: Processes and sells raw and processed milk from the acquired Arps Dairy facility to a single significant customer.
segments.evidence: Following the Acquisition, we are also engaged in providing raw and processed milk to a single significant customer.

revenueModel.text: Institutional and national account customers, sold through distributors, pay for frozen beverages and food; one customer pays for raw and processed milk.
revenueModel.evidence: The Company conducts sales through several channels, including National Accounts, Regional Accounts, and Broadline Distributors.

changes.text: In 2025 the Arps Dairy acquisition added the Raw and Processed Milk segment alongside Frozen Beverages and Food.
changes.evidence: As a result of the Acquisition, we operate in two reportable segments: Frozen Beverages and Food, and Raw and Processed Milk.
